## The question

**In one or two short paragraphs, introduce the setting, audience, focused research question, data source, observational unit, response, important predictors, and one important data limitation. Lead with what makes the question worth answering.**

Using the myriad of data recorded in basketball games, such as how well a team shoots, how well a team defense, or how well a team rebounds, we want to analyze which metrics most correlate to winning basketball games. Does a team performing well in a certain metric indicate they will have a good season? Are there certain things a team should focus improvement on if they want to win more games? The findings from this analysis can be valuable in helping teams improve and find more success over the course of a season. It can also point toward important attributes to look for in inidividual players recruited out of high school or in the transfer portal.
